name: @moyarich/auto-glow-md
description: Shell-native Oh My Zsh plugin that automatically renders Markdown terminal output with Glow.

scripts.test: npm run test:syntax && npm run test:shell
scripts.test:shell: zsh test/run-tests.zsh && zsh test/install-completion.test.zsh && zsh test/zle-interoperability.test.zsh
scripts.test:dist: npm run build && zsh -n dist/moyarich-auto-glow-md.plugin.zsh && zsh -n dist/lib/core.zsh && zsh -n dist/bin/moyarich-auto-glow-md.sh && sh -n dist/install.sh && sh -n dist/uninstall.sh && MOYARICH_AUTO_GLOW_DISABLE_RENDER=1 ./dist/bin/moyarich-auto-glow-md.sh -- printf '%s' '# CLI works'
scripts.test:syntax: zsh -n moyarich-auto-glow-md.plugin.zsh && zsh -n lib/core.zsh && zsh -n src/cli/moyarich-auto-glow-md.sh && sh -n install.sh && sh -n uninstall.sh
scripts.test:glow: command -v glow >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'glow is required for test:glow' >&2; exit 1; }; npm run build && ./dist/bin/moyarich-auto-glow-md.sh -- printf '%s\n' '# CLI works' && completion_file="$(mktemp)" && trap 'rm -f "$completion_file"' EXIT && glow completion zsh > "$completion_file" && test -s "$completion_file" && grep -q '#compdef glow' "$completion_file"
